tool.extract.merge_option: Merge extracted pages in one PDF file
tool.extract.all_desc: Every page of this PDF will be converted into a separate PDF file.
tool.extract.tip: Click on the pages you want to extract.
workspace.preview.blank.title: Is the PDF preview blank or showing a blocked page?
workspace.preview.blank.desc: Don't worry! This is a standard security restriction enforced by modern web browsers when rendering {blob} PDF assets inside nested developer iframes.
workspace.preview.blank.list1: ✓ Your processed PDF is 100% complete & secure.
workspace.preview.blank.list2: ✓ It will display instantly when downloaded or opened in a direct browser tab.
tool.sign.editor_desc: Scroll through your document below. Click \"Add Signature\" on any page to drop your signature. Drag it to your desired position.
tool.merge.tip.title: 🌟 SUPER MERGE
tool.merge.tip.desc: You can upload dozens of documents at once. Don't forget to drag the file boxes on the left to organize the order before processing!
tool.split.tip.title: 💡 SMALL FILE TRICK
tool.split.tip.desc: Only need a few pages from a hundreds-page PDF? Extracting them here will make the file much lighter to share.
tool.rotate.tip.title: 🔄 QUICK FIX
tool.rotate.tip.desc: Often get upside-down pages from Scanner errors? Click the pages on the left screen to rotate them in seconds!
tool.delete-pages.tip.title: 🗑️ REMOVE BLANKS
tool.delete-pages.tip.desc: Get rid of unnecessary cover pages or blank pages at the end of the document to make your file look neater and more professional.
tool.extract-pages.tip.title: 🎯 FOCUS ON CORE
tool.extract-pages.tip.desc: Unlike the delete feature, this allows you to filter and pick only specific pages to create a brand new PDF.
tool.protect.tip.title: 🔒 MILITARY ENCRYPTION
tool.protect.tip.desc: Your password is locked with a strong algorithm standard. We do not store this password, so make sure you don't forget it!
tool.unlock.tip.title: 🔓 UNLOCK ONCE
tool.unlock.tip.desc: Remove the encryption layer from your document so you don't have to retype the password every time you open the file.
tool.sign.tip.title: ✍️ WYSIWYG SIGNATURE
tool.sign.tip.desc: Drag your signature precisely to the desired line. What you see on the screen is what you get!
tool.redact.tip.title: ⬛ PERMANENT CENSOR
tool.redact.tip.desc: This box is not just a black sticker! It permanently removes the text data behind it so it cannot be copy-pasted anymore.
tool.image-to-pdf.tip.title: 🖼️ IMAGE TO PDF
tool.image-to-pdf.tip.desc: Upload JPG, PNG, or WEBP images — multiple at once! Drag the cards to reorder them before converting. Choose your page size: A4, Letter, or Fit to Image.
tool.pdf-to-image.tip.title: 🖼️ IDEAL FOR SOCIALS
tool.pdf-to-image.tip.desc: PDF files cannot be posted on social feeds. Convert to high-res JPG/PNG here so they can be easily shared!
tool.html-to-pdf.tip.title: 🌐 INVOICE & RECEIPTS
tool.html-to-pdf.tip.desc: Very useful for pasting raw receipt code or web articles and turning them into neat print-ready PDF documents.
tool.add-watermark.tip.title: ©️ PROTECT YOUR WORK
tool.add-watermark.tip.desc: Use a low transparency level (opacity) so the copyright stamp protects the document without interrupting the original text content.
tool.add-page-numbers.tip.title: 🔢 OFFICIAL STANDARD
tool.add-page-numbers.tip.desc: Most institutions and universities require page numbers in specific corners of documents. Get it done in one click here!
tool.merge.title: Merge PDF
tool.merge.howto.1: Upload two or more PDF files into the dropzone area.
tool.merge.howto.2: Drag and drop the file thumbnails to arrange their merge order.
tool.merge.howto.3: Click the 'Run Merge PDF' button to merge files locally in your browser.
tool.merge.tips.1: You can visually reorder your files at any time before clicking merge.
tool.split.title: Split PDF
tool.split.desc: Extract specific page ranges or split a PDF into separate files.
tool.split.howto.1: Upload the PDF document you want to split.
tool.split.howto.2: Click on the pages you want to extract as independent PDFs.
tool.split.howto.3: Click 'Run Split PDF' to download them as a ZIP file.
tool.split.tips.1: If you do not select any pages, the tool will automatically split all pages in the document into single PDF files.
tool.rotate.title: Rotate PDF
tool.rotate.desc: Rotate specific pages or all pages in your PDF by 90, 180, or 270 degrees.
tool.rotate.howto.1: Upload your PDF file into the dropzone.
tool.rotate.howto.2: Choose the desired rotation angle and specify the target pages.
tool.rotate.howto.3: Click 'Run Rotate PDF' to apply rotation to the document layers.
tool.rotate.tips.1: Rotation is applied visually and structurally to ensure accurate printing.
tool.protect.title: Protect PDF
tool.protect.desc: Encrypt and secure your PDF document with a strong password locally.
tool.protect.howto.1: Select the PDF document you want to secure.
tool.protect.howto.2: Type a strong password in the configuration field to lock the file.
tool.protect.howto.3: Click 'Run Protect PDF' to secure the file entirely in your browser.
tool.protect.tips.1: Make sure you remember the password as it cannot be recovered once applied.
tool.unlock.title: Unlock PDF
tool.unlock.desc: Remove password security and encryption from your unlocked PDF.
tool.unlock.howto.1: Upload your encrypted or password-protected PDF file.
tool.unlock.howto.2: Type the current password in the decryption password input field.
tool.unlock.howto.3: Click 'Run Unlock PDF' to strip away the file protection.
tool.unlock.tips.1: You must know the original password to unlock the document.
tool.sign.title: Sign PDF
tool.sign.desc: Add your electronic signature to documents locally and securely.
tool.sign.howto.1: Upload your PDF document to reveal the visual grid.
tool.sign.howto.2: In the right panel, create your signature and adjust its size.
tool.sign.howto.3: Click 'Add Signature' on any page in the visual grid to drop the signature.
tool.sign.tips.1: You can place your signature on multiple pages. Click the 'X' button in the 'Signatures Placed' list to remove a signature.
tool.image_to_pdf.title: Image to PDF
tool.image_to_pdf.desc: Convert JPG, PNG, WebP, and other images into a polished PDF document.
tool.image_to_pdf.howto.1: Upload one or more images (JPG, PNG, or WEBP) — you can select multiple files at once.
tool.image_to_pdf.howto.2: Drag and drop the image cards to arrange the order they will appear in the PDF.
tool.image_to_pdf.howto.3: Choose a page size (A4, Letter, or Fit to Image), then click 'Run Image to PDF'.
tool.image_to_pdf.tips.1: Use 'Fit to Image' for photos to preserve the original dimensions without stretching or cropping.
tool.pdf_to_image.title: PDF to Image
tool.pdf_to_image.desc: Extract raw images or render PDF pages as high-quality JPG/PNG files.
tool.pdf_to_image.howto.1: Upload your original PDF document into the dropzone.
tool.pdf_to_image.howto.2: Click the extraction button to scan and render all pages as images.
tool.pdf_to_image.howto.3: Download high-quality rendered page images directly to your local storage.
tool.pdf_to_image.tips.1: Rendering large documents may take a few seconds depending on your device.
tool.delete_pages.title: Delete Pages
tool.delete_pages.desc: Remove unwanted pages from your PDF file and shrink document size.
tool.delete_pages.howto.1: Upload your PDF document to reveal the visual grid.
tool.delete_pages.howto.2: Click the trash icon directly on any page you want to remove.
tool.delete_pages.howto.3: Click 'Run Delete Pages' to remove the selected pages.
tool.delete_pages.tips.1: Deleted pages will be greyed out. Click the undo button on the page to restore it easily.
tool.extract_pages.title: Extract Pages
tool.extract_pages.desc: Select and save only the pages you need as a separate new PDF.
tool.extract_pages.howto.1: Upload your PDF file to reveal the visual grid.
tool.extract_pages.howto.2: Click directly on any page you want to extract.
tool.extract_pages.howto.3: Choose your merge preference and click 'Run Extract Pages'.
tool.extract_pages.tips.1: Selected pages will be highlighted. Click again to undo your selection easily.
tool.add_watermark.title: Add Watermark
tool.add_watermark.desc: Stamp custom text or images over pages with customized opacity and size.
tool.add_page_numbers.title: Add Page Numbers
tool.add_page_numbers.desc: Insert customized page numbers into your PDF easily with perfect layouts.
tool.add_page_numbers.howto.1: Upload the PDF document you want to number.
tool.add_page_numbers.howto.2: Select the position and the number format (e.g., 'Page 1 of 10').
tool.add_page_numbers.howto.3: Adjust the text size and color to match your document's style.
tool.add_page_numbers.tips.1: Avoid placing numbers in corners if your document has content there to prevent overlapping.
tool.html_to_pdf.title: HTML to PDF
tool.html_to_pdf.desc: Convert web page screenshots, rich text, or HTML content into PDF files.
tool.html_to_pdf.howto.1: Type or paste your rich text or HTML document in the editor.
tool.html_to_pdf.howto.2: Use preloaded templates to start quickly.
tool.html_to_pdf.howto.3: Click 'Compile PDF Document' to generate the document locally.
tool.html_to_pdf.tips.1: Use inline CSS styles to ensure accurate formatting in the final PDF.
tool.redact.title: Redact PDF
tools.ocr.description: Extract text from scanned images and PDFs easily.
tool.ocr.howto.1: Upload an image or scanned document into the dropzone.
tool.ocr.howto.2: Wait for the OCR engine to initialize and process the document.
tool.ocr.howto.3: Review the extracted text in the result box.
tool.ocr.howto.4: Click \"Copy to Clipboard\" to save the text for your use.
tool.ocr.tips.1: Make sure the image is clear and well-lit for the best text recognition accuracy.
tool.ocr.tips.2: The OCR engine runs entirely in your browser without uploading your sensitive documents.
tools.reorder.description: Drag and drop to reorder PDF pages visually.
tool.reorder.howto.1: Upload the PDF document you want to reorder.
tool.reorder.howto.2: Drag and drop the page thumbnails to arrange them into your preferred sequence.
tool.reorder.howto.3: Click \"Run Reorder PDF\" to generate the newly sorted document.
tool.reorder.howto.4: Preview the result or download it directly to your device.
tool.reorder.tips.1: Reordering is non-destructive; your original PDF file remains untouched.
tool.reorder.tips.2: Combine this with the \"Extract Pages\" tool if you only need a specific portion of the rearranged file.

tool.merge.instruction: Upload two or more PDF files. They will be merged in the order shown in the list.
tool.split.instruction: Upload a PDF, then click on the page thumbnails below to select the pages you want to extract.
tool.rotate.instruction: Upload a PDF, then rotate individual pages using the thumbnail controls, or use the bulk rotate buttons below.
tool.delete.instruction: Upload a PDF, then click the trash icon on each thumbnail to mark pages for deletion.
tool.extract.instruction: Upload a PDF and type the page numbers you want to keep (e.g. 1, 3-5).
tool.reorder.instruction: Upload a PDF, then drag and drop the page thumbnails to reorder them.
tool.protect.instruction: Upload a PDF, choose a strong password below, then click Run to encrypt and lock the file.
tool.unlock.instruction: Upload a password-protected PDF, enter its current password in the field below, then click Run to unlock it.
tool.watermark.instruction: Upload a PDF and customize the watermark text, size, color, and opacity using the options below.
tool.page_num.instruction: Upload a PDF and choose where to display the page numbers (bottom center, top right, etc.).
tool.sign.instruction: Draw your signature on the pad below. After drawing, a live preview will appear — drag the signature to your desired position.
tool.sign.sidebar_instruction: Draw your signature in the canvas below. Then use the page preview to drag the signature to its final position.
tool.redact.instruction: Upload a PDF. Thumbnails of each page will appear. Click on the area you want to black out, then click Run.
tool.html.instruction: Type or paste your HTML content in the editor. You can also select a template to get started quickly.
tool.image.instruction: Upload one or more images (PNG, JPG, WebP). They will be combined into a single PDF in the order shown.
tool.pdf_to_image.instruction: Upload a PDF to extract every page as a high-resolution PNG or JPEG image.
tool.add_watermark.instruction: Upload a PDF and configure your watermark's text, size, color, and opacity using the settings below.
tool.add_watermark.howto.1: Upload the PDF document you want to stamp with a watermark.
tool.add_watermark.howto.2: Look at the live preview to instantly see how the watermark will appear.
tool.add_watermark.howto.3: Use the settings panel to change the text, color, size, rotation, and opacity.
tool.add_watermark.howto.4: Click 'Save & Download PDF' to finalize your watermarked document.
tool.add_watermark.tips.1: Use a semi-transparent color (lower opacity) to ensure the original content remains readable.
tool.add_watermark.tips.2: A diagonal rotation (like 45°) is usually the hardest to remove and covers the page evenly.
tool.add_watermark.tips.3: For confidential documents, a bright red color is standard to immediately catch attention.
tool.add_page_numbers.instruction: Upload a PDF and customize your page numbering style, position, size, and color below.
tool.add_page_numbers.howto.4: Click 'Save & Download PDF' to apply the numbering.
tool.add_page_numbers.tips.2: Standard formatting usually requires page numbers in the top-right or bottom-center.
tool.add_page_numbers.tips.3: Using the 'Page 1 of 10' format helps readers know exactly how long the document is.
